description: A game the difficulty starts with techs already finished. `very-easy` grants Socioanalytics and Advanced Socioanalytics, and both are finished at creation with their consequences applied in that order, which is the only way a Scenario can reach display_discover: researching either of them costs thousands of CPU-days. It stays inside the grace period, which very-easy never leaves on CPU, so nothing rolls and the two days are about the state creation left behind.
